title: Eye movement as a mediator of the relationships among time pressure, feedback, and learning performance
reason: Lab experiment (24 students) where eye-tracker fixations (Tobii X2-30) mediate time-pressure and feedback effects on learning-task time and correctness (SEM). Eye-tracking is not an LMS-measurable indicator or activity product; no LMS indicator is analysed.

extraction.n_quote: Twenty-four undergraduate and graduate students [10 females and
extraction.population: undergraduate and graduate students naive to project management
extraction.outcome_or_construct: task completion time, correct answers in self-paced learning trials
extraction.notes: If eye-movement measures were deemed in scope, this would be an I1 candidate; adjudicator may reconsider. Experimental factors are time-to-deadline and feedback.
